tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, tables, menus, modals, the header bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, filter panel, code-like values (ids, TTN), skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and select borders, checkbox outlines; 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, helper text, table captions, placeholders; on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Electric blue. Primary buttons, links, the active nav item, selected states, the focus ring. As text, on surface, surface-raised and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind primary text: selected filter chips, the active row, info notices.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Volt yellow highlight, used sparingly: the wordmark bar, the cart count badge, a 'new' or 'best price' tag. A FILL only in light theme (1.3:1 as text on surface); text on it is on-volt.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a volt fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: In stock, paid, delivered, saved. As text or icon on surface-raised and success-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success chips and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, out of stock, cancelled, destructive buttons (outline style). As text or icon on surface-raised and danger-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and danger chips.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting states: awaiting payment, cancelling, TTN pending, inactive product. As text or icon on surface-raised and warning-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips and notices.

tokens.name: art-blue
tokens.usage: Product placeholder ground, first category slot; its icon is primary.

tokens.name: art-yellow
tokens.usage: Product placeholder ground, second category slot; its icon is art-yellow-ink.

tokens.name: art-yellow-ink
tokens.usage: Placeholder icon on art-yellow (5.5:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: art-mint
tokens.usage: Product placeholder ground, third category slot; its icon is success.

tokens.name: art-coral
tokens.usage: Product placeholder ground, fourth category slot; its icon is art-coral-ink.

tokens.name: art-coral-ink
tokens.usage: Placeholder icon on art-coral (4.8:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links; an alias of primary.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset in the ground colour; 5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the storefront heading on wide screens. 32px/36px below 600px.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles: product name, Cart, Checkout, staff screen titles.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a page, modal titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, form group titles, product tile titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ships with Nova Poshta within two working days.
styles.usage: Default text, form inputs, product descriptions (max 68 characters a line).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, table cells that lead a row, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, staff table cells, chips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: table column headers, filter group names, status chips.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on tiles and totals; tabular figures. 28px/32px on the product page and the order total.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Identifiers: product and order UUIDs, TTN numbers, card test numbers. On surface-sunken when shown as a value block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form field gap, table cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, grid gutter on phones, page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, product grid gutter, section gap inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, header-to-content distance.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page padding on desktop, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, modals, notices; Mantine's default radius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product image placeholder on the product page, the checkout summary panel.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Product tiles on hover, the sticky header when scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, modals, notifications.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; centred, with space-4 (phone) or space-6 (desktop) side gutters.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header height on every screen; 56px below 600px.

tokens.name: filter-panel
tokens.usage: Width of the storefront filter column on desktop; it becomes a drawer below 900px.
